pages.text: Upgrading the regular $(l:basics/watering_can)Watering Can$() with essences and $(l:advances/mystical_fertilizer)Mystical Fertilizer$() improves your farming experience a ton. $(br2)Upgraded Watering Cans have improved range and growth acceleration speed. You can also toggle automatic watering by Shift + Right Clicking with the Watering Can while not targeting a block.
